_comment: Brand-centric view of real astrology/psychic advertisers harvested from the US Meta Ad Library on 2026-07-31. tagline/positioning are synthesized from each brand's actual ad copy. Ads are shown oldest-first (oldest active = most scalable). Play link: https://www.facebook.com/ads/library/?id=<libraryId>

brands.positioning: Relationship-only psychic chat, first 3 minutes free. Leans hard on "human, not a bot" trust.

ads.hook: Looking for real relationship guidance that actually helps?
Real human psychics — never AI. First 3 minutes free.
She felt lost and unsure. One late-night chat changed everything.
Wondering about his intentions? Our psychics see what you can't.

brands.tagline: Stop second-guessing. Get the answers you deserve.
brands.positioning: "Ask 3 questions about your future" quiz funnel; reading emailed in 1–2 days.

ads.hook: Unsure whether you're with the right person? Ask 3 questions about your future.
Clear answers to your love and life questions — a vision of what lies ahead.
Questioning the future of your relationship? Guidance on your next steps in love.
Stop second-guessing and start getting the answers you deserve.

brands.positioning: Skeptic-to-believer UGC: specificity as proof (initials, dates), then a personalized reading.

ads.hook: POV: a soulmate reader calls out your girlfriend's exact initials. I'm still shook.

brands.positioning: Trust-by-reviews. Free-reading giveaway + Trustpilot social proof. Longest-running ad in the set.

ads.hook: You could win a FREE reading today — over 30,000 5★ reviews on Trustpilot.

brands.tagline: Your cosmic blueprint — birth chart, aura & soulmate portrait.
brands.positioning: Quiz/portrait hooks ("what does your aura colour say?"). App-install, personalization angle.

ads.hook: What does your aura colour say about your personality?

brands.tagline: Confused by your love-life? Get hope and a way forward.
brands.positioning: Short love-reading hooks driving app installs. Emotion-forward, quick.

ads.hook: Confused by your love-life? Need hope and the best way forward? Get your Love Reading.

brands.tagline: This time tomorrow, you could have clarity and comfort.
brands.positioning: Ultra-short reassurance hook — fast promise of relief, minimal copy.

ads.hook: This time tomorrow, you could have clarity and comfort. Get a reading today.

brands.positioning: Product-bundle + discount offer. Social-proof volume, aspirational.

ads.hook: The $99 bundle everyone's talking about: jewelry + astrology, worth $200+.

brands.tagline: Your million-dollar era — mapped from your chart.
brands.positioning: Founder story + AI 'strategist' built on Human Design + astrology. $37 entry.

ads.hook: Something finally saw me accurately — your business strategy, mapped from your chart.
